description: Source code implementing thread creation and management primitives for ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R architectures in Zephyr RTOS, including context setup, stack guard handling, user mode transition, and FPU control.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Initializes a new thread context, setting up stack frame, mode, and optional FPU and user space configurations.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions execution to user mode with specified entry point and parameters, setting up privileged stack and guard areas.

methods.name: z_arm_thread_is_in_user_mode
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is running in user mode based on CPSR register.

methods.name: z_check_thread_stack_fail
methods.description: Assesses whether a memory fault indicates stack corruption for the current thread, considering MPU guard regions and user mode.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables floating point capabilities for the current thread.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Indicates that enabling FPU is unsupported on Cortex-A/R in this implementation.
